lead: Few stories so far on October 4: how to run agents safely and efficiently, and fallout from an OpenAI safety lead's resignation.

sections.title: Agents and how we work with them
sections.intro: Practical views on running agents: spend limits, how to prompt a long-running Opus 5.5, and why documentation may beat memory plugins.

sections.title: Safety culture and government response
sections.intro: A safety lead leaves OpenAI warning about culture, while the White House sets up an AI task force.
